title: stays-local.json
description: Declares how to build an app and what remote addresses it contains, so the stays local check can be run against it. See spec/core.md.

platform.description: Selects the verifier. Only platforms with an implemented verifier can be certified today.

repository.description: Public source. Required — a closed-source app cannot be certified.

build.description: Command that builds the artifact into $STAYS_LOCAL_OUT. Must need no secrets and must not require network access it cannot do without.

bundle.description: Artifact name inside $STAYS_LOCAL_OUT, e.g. "My App.app" or "app-release.apk".

declared_urls.description: Every remote address that appears in the artifact, each with a reason. Declaring is disclosure, not exemption: declared addresses are published on the registry entry. An empty array is the strongest position.

url.description: Host only, no scheme and no path, e.g. "store.steampowered.com".

reason.description: Why the address is in the binary and what touches it. "Opened in the user's browser; the app never connects" is the common legitimate case.
